content: Node crypto.createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest() to sign; verify by recomputing HMAC over the received payload and comparing via crypto.timingSafeEqual(bufA, bufB) — never ===, which is vulnerable to timing attacks. Both buffers passed to timingSafeEqual must be equal length (SHA-256 digest is fixed 32 bytes). No jsonwebtoken dependency needed for a simple signed-payload nonce. Cross-checked against nodejs.org/api/crypto.html.
